cpu_contract.execution: Local x86-32 effects only, if the instruction is reached and completes without fault. Encoded branch/call destinations are numerical; no target, provider or encoded cell contents were queried.
cpu_contract.opaque_returns: Four call sites are opaque and none is proved to return. Each conditional saved continuation begins with newly unconstrained EAX, ECX, EBP, ESP and every other register, flags, segment selectors/descriptors/attributes, memory and provider state. No relation to earlier state or stack slots is inferred.
cpu_contract.stack_rule: At every implicit PUSH, CALL, POP or RET separately require actual current SS.B=1 before using a full-ESP equation. Program decode width does not prove SS stack size. Renew after every opaque call; with another or unknown stack-address attribute the ESP equations are not asserted. All offsets below are modulo 2^32. There is no explicit ADD ESP instruction in these captured bytes.

instruction_primitives.push: For current ESP=S and immediate V, successful PUSH32 writes dword V through current SS at S-4 and leaves ESP=S-4. No arithmetic flags change.
instruction_primitives.call: For current ESP=S, successful E8 CALL writes its encoded next address through current SS at S-4, leaves ESP=S-4, and transfers to its numeric target. The instruction preserves other general registers and arithmetic flags; its opaque target has no established preservation.
instruction_primitives.pop_ecx: Read the current dword through current SS at current ESP=S, write it to ECX, and leave ESP=S+4. POP ECX does not change arithmetic flags. The read is current memory, not an authenticated original caller value.
instruction_primitives.ret: At C05BA0 read the current dword through SS at current ESP=S as next EIP and leave ESP=S+4 under the renewed stack predicate. No original return address or restored frame is authenticated; arithmetic flags are unchanged.

cpu_contract.incoming_edge_and_entry: The accepted prior BFBA09 E8 edge writes return BFBA0E at T-4 and enters C05B68 with ESP=T-4 only under its own successful current-SS32 predicate. Entry 6A03 pushes sign-extended +3. C05B6A writes return C05B6F and calls numeric C26B57. Each current implicit-stack predicate is required independently; no state survives the opaque target by assumption.
cpu_contract.first_return_and_branch: If the first call resumes at C05B6F, let A be current EAX and S current ESP. CMP EAX,1 sets flags from 32-bit A-1 without writing EAX. POP ECX at C05B72 reads current SS:[S] and changes ECX/stack pointer only; its success preserves the CMP flags. JZ at C05B73 takes C05B8A exactly when A==1, otherwise falls through C05B75. Faults are outside this successful path.
cpu_contract.second_call_path: At C05B75 push sign-extended +3 through current SS, then C05B77 calls the same numeric C26B57 with encoded return C05B7C. At a conditional return all state is unknown again. Let B be current EAX: TEST EAX,EAX sets ZF=(B==0), SF=bit31(B), PF=even parity(low byte B), clears CF/OF and leaves AF undefined, without writing EAX. POP ECX at C05B7E preserves these flags. JNZ at C05B7F takes C05BA0 if B!=0, otherwise C05B81.
cpu_contract.current_memory_comparison: Only on that fallthrough, C05B81 reads current dword M through default current DS at encoded 32-bit offset 00E1558C. CMP M,sign_extend(01) sets subtraction flags without storing to that cell. JNZ at C05B88 takes C05BA0 if M!=1, otherwise C05B8A. The DS selector/base/limits/permissions and M are unknown; the cell was not queried and no provider identity is authenticated.
cpu_contract.common_call_sequence: At C05B8A opcode 68 pushes the full imm32 000000FC (252), then C05B8F calls numeric C059A8 with return C05B94. If it returns, every state component is unknown. At C05B94 opcode 68 pushes imm32 000000FF (255), then C05B99 calls the same numeric C059A8 with return C05B9E. Neither immediate is a sign-extended imm8 -4 or -1, and neither has an established argument or service meaning.
cpu_contract.last_return_and_stack_reads: If the fourth call resumes at C05B9E with ESP=Q, two successful POP ECX instructions read current SS:[Q] then current SS:[Q+4] and leave ESP=Q+8 only under renewed current-SS32 predicates and the local sequential state. The second read overwrites ECX from the first. RET reads current SS:[Q+8] and leaves ESP=Q+12 under its own predicate. Q has no established relation to any earlier ESP; the three reads are not authenticated cleanup or caller return slots.

CMP_flags.R: (X-1) mod 2^32, X=current EAX or current DS dword as applicable

cpu_contract.order_and_aliases: Each comparison or stack read observes memory/registers at that exact point. Absolute DS memory may alias stack memory because segment bases and addresses are unknown; no disjointness is assumed. Earlier stack writes and opaque call side effects can affect later reads. Flags consumed by the first two branches were established before the intervening POP, which does not alter flags; the third branch follows its CMP directly. No expression is silently reordered across a read, write or opaque call.
